title: Kenyan Bean Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Kenya, made with a variety of beans and spices.

ingredients.name: zesty
ingredients.notes: such as hot sauce or lemon juice

ingredients.name: kenyan
ingredients.notes: such as ground ginger or cumin

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add bean, stew, zesty, kenyan, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season to taste and serve hot.
